title: OpenAI Five Benchmark: Results
summary: Yesterday, OpenAI Five won a best-of-three against a team of 99.95th percentile Dota players: Blitz, Cap, Fogged, Merlini, and MoonMeander—four of whom have played Dota professionally—in front of a live audience and 100,000 concurrent livestream viewers.
body: Yesterday, OpenAI Five won a best-of-three against a team of 99.95th percentile Dota players: Blitz, Cap, Fogged, Merlini, and MoonMeander—four of whom have played Dota professionally—in front of a live audience and 100,000 concurrent livestream viewers.
summaryZh: OpenAI Five在公开表演赛中击败了由职业选手组成的顶尖战队，这是AI在复杂实时策略游戏领域取得的重大突破。该模型通过大规模强化学习训练，在多人协作、长期规划及资源管理方面表现出极高的竞技水平，为后续智能体技术的发展提供了关键的基准测试数据与方法论参考。

aiReview.reasonZh: 这是强化学习领域的重要里程碑，标志着AI在复杂多人协作博弈中达到职业选手水平。
